title: Amazon Product Intelligence Actor
description: Give the Actor ASINs, product URLs or discovery inputs, choose the data depth, and filter search cards before detail fetches. Every input is accounted for as a product result or a structured failure row.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: fast = listing data for discovery inputs; direct ASINs/URLs still require an Essential detail fetch. detail = product page. intelligence = detail plus selected competitive blocks. monitor = compare current product state with a previous dataset.

dataProfile.title: Data profile
dataProfile.description: Choose the result depth and base billing event. Essential returns price, availability and ratings with product-essential billing. Catalog adds BSR, Buy Box, variants, content and media with product-detail billing. Competitive also enables offers and seller profiles, which use their own events. Custom lets you choose individual blocks.

dataBlocks.title: Custom data blocks
dataBlocks.description: Used when Data profile is Custom. Identity, source, location and quality metadata are always returned. Offers and seller profiles have separate per-result billing events.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Which Amazon marketplace to use. Product URLs from a different marketplace are respected and reported per record.

asins.title: ASINs
asins.description: One or more 10-character ASINs, e.g. B0CX23V2ZK. Invalid entries are returned as INVALID_INPUT rows rather than dropped.

urls.title: Amazon URLs
urls.description: Product, search, category, best-seller, storefront or seller URLs.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search keywords. Each keyword is crawled up to 'Max search pages'.

discoveryFilters.title: Search discovery filters
discoveryFilters.description: Filter keyword, category, best-seller and storefront cards before detail pages are queued or billed. Direct ASIN and product URL inputs bypass these filters. When a requested signal is missing from a card, the card is excluded rather than guessed.

items.title: Raw JSON items
items.description: Advanced bulk input. Each object contains exactly one of asin, url or keyword. Optional per-row marketplace is supported for ASINs and keywords.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Optional marketplace override for this row.

datasetId.title: Input dataset ID
datasetId.description: Read inputs from an existing Apify dataset instead of pasting them.

datasetField.title: Input dataset field
datasetField.description: Which field of the input dataset holds the ASIN or URL.

deliveryCountry.title: Delivery country
deliveryCountry.description: Optional delivery context. Amazon shows different prices and delivery promises by location.

postalCode.title: Postal code
postalCode.description: Optional postal code, e.g. 10001. Applied once per session and verified from the page. Every record reports whether it was applied.

requireLocation.title: Require the location to be applied
requireLocation.description: When on, a product whose delivery location could not be applied is returned as REQUIRES_LOCATION instead of a success with an unlocalized price. Recommended for price tracking.

variantMode.title: Variant mode
variantMode.description: none = skip. discover = child ASINs and option matrix at no extra request cost (default). price = also fetch each child's current price and stock. full = full detail per child.
enumTitles: Discover - child ASINs + options (no extra cost)
Price - child prices and stock (extra requests)
Full - full detail per child (most expensive)

includeOffers.title: Include all offers
includeOffers.description: Fetch the bounded All Offers surface for each product. Adds requests and offer billing events.

maxOffersPerProduct.title: Max offers per product
maxOffersPerProduct.description: Hard limit on offers retained and billed for each product.

includeSellerDetails.title: Include public seller details
includeSellerDetails.description: Fetch public seller profile, feedback and business fields for discovered sellers. No private identity inference.

maxProducts.title: Max products
maxProducts.description: Hard ceiling on products processed in this run.

maxSearchPages.title: Max search pages per keyword
maxSearchPages.description: Hard pagination limit for each keyword, category, best-seller or storefront discovery input.

maxVariants.title: Max variants per parent
maxVariants.description: Ceiling on deep child fetches. Discovery is unaffected.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: Maximum bounded retry count before a fetch is reported as failed or blocked.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate results
deduplicate.description: Deduplicate on marketplace + ASIN + resolved delivery location. Discovery sources are merged into discoveredFrom rather than emitted twice.

allowResidentialFallback.title: Allow residential proxy fallback
allowResidentialFallback.description: When off, the Actor never escalates to residential proxies and returns BLOCKED instead. Cheaper and fully predictable, at a higher block rate.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Amazon requires proxies. High-volume users can supply their own external proxy URLs here, which keeps that traffic off the platform bill entirely.

schemaVersion.title: Expected schema version
schemaVersion.description: Echo of the output schema your integration expects. A mismatch produces a run warning, never a failure.

compareWithDatasetId.title: Previous dataset ID
compareWithDatasetId.description: Prior Amazon Product Intelligence dataset used for field-level monitoring changes. Required in monitor mode.
